assertions.assertion: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation.
The service is supported by diagnosis codes I49.5, I49.9, and R00.2.
The claim was denied under denial code CO-22.
The patient's documented palpitations and symptomatic bradycardia establish a clinical basis for the continuous ambulatory Holter study.
